name: CCP Chronology of Constitutional Events
citation: Elkins, Zachary, Tom Ginsburg, and James Melton. 2026. Chronology of Constitutional Events, Version 6. Comparative Constitutions Project. Last modified April 6, 2026.

license.statement: The official download page and v6 archive provide public data and a requested citation but do not include an explicit reuse license. No CC or public-domain license is asserted. Full constitutional texts are not included or republished.

source_notes: The v6 codebook specifies 1789–2025 and 20,638 country-year rows. Most source entities retain annual non-event rows only through 2019; later event additions are sparse. Missing later rows are unknown, not evidence of no constitutional change.
The archive manifest still says Version 5 and describes a v4–v5 comparison; the v6 codebook, CSV filename and official download page identify this release as version 6.
The download page cites Elkins and Ginsburg; the packaged v6 codebook also names James Melton. Attribution here follows the codebook.
The source has duplicate country-year observations for Burkina Faso 2022, Sudan 2019 and Syria 2025. All source rows are preserved; source row number identifies each independently.
The codebook does not define the source event code samendment; it is retained literally without an invented expansion.

version_differences.txt.local_transformation: Removed the upstream author home-directory prefix from two log-path lines; retained repository-independent relative log paths. All research content is unchanged.
